narrative.overview:
The system treats a personal technical portfolio as a clearly edited professional record: hierarchy makes the information easy to scan, typography carries the voice, and fine rules separate entries without framing each item as a card. The hero introduces a general first-person summary of how I work; specific client evidence appears in the experience timeline. Its mood is calm, direct, and evidence-led for recruiters and technical managers.

Warm paper and forest green anchor the canvas; IBM Plex Sans handles reading and interface text, while Georgia marks display headings. Responsive grids align related content on wide screens and reflow into readable columns on phones. Rust supplies a restrained pointer for arrows, indexes, hover, and keyboard focus.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green carries primary emphasis; rust is a restrained pointer.
IBM Plex Sans handles reading and controls; Georgia marks display hierarchy.
Warm paper, ink, and fine rules keep the canvas quiet and legible.
Open grids and flat section bands provide structure without shadows.

rules.name: The Green Structure Rule
rules.body: Forest green establishes hierarchy; rust stays a small directional and focus accent.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Sans for reading and controls; reserve Georgia for display headings and subheadings.

rules.name: The Paper-Plane Rule
rules.body: Paper shifts and fine rules define planes; no shadow treatment is part of the current system.

dos: Do use forest green for primary emphasis and actions, with rust reserved for small directional and focus cues.
Do let warm paper, ink, whitespace, and fine rules organize reading surfaces.
Do keep IBM Plex Sans on reading and interface text, with Georgia for display hierarchy.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and respect reduced-motion settings.
donts: Don't add rounded corners to the primary action or the current row patterns.
Don't treat shadows as an existing depth token; the implementation uses tonal shifts and rules instead.
Don't use rust as a broad surface color; it is an accent in the current palette.
